scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.test:integration:coverage: c8 --all --include "backend/src/rules/impl/*.ts" --exclude "backend/src/rules/impl/template-game.ts" --reporter=text-summary --reporter=json-summary --report-dir test-artifacts/integration-coverage sh -c "npm run test:integration && npm run test:integration:coverage:explore"
scripts.semgrep: if command -v semgrep > /dev/null 2>&1; then semgrep scan --config auto --error; else echo "⚠️  Semgrep not found, skipping security scan."; fi
scripts.supabase:init: sh -c 'REPO_DIR="$PWD"; cd /tmp && NODE_OPTIONS= npx --yes supabase init --workdir "$REPO_DIR" "$@"' --
scripts.supabase:link: sh -c 'REPO_DIR="$PWD"; cd /tmp && NODE_OPTIONS= npx --yes supabase link --workdir "$REPO_DIR" "$@"' --
scripts.supabase:db:push: sh -c 'REPO_DIR="$PWD"; cd /tmp && NODE_OPTIONS= npx --yes supabase db push --workdir "$REPO_DIR" "$@"' --
scripts.supabase:db:pull: sh -c 'REPO_DIR="$PWD"; cd /tmp && NODE_OPTIONS= npx --yes supabase db pull --workdir "$REPO_DIR" "$@"' --
scripts.render: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; if [ -z "$RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL" ]; then echo "Missing RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL."; exit 1; fi; curl -fsS -X POST "$RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL"
scripts.vercel: REPO_DIR=$PWD && COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && COMMIT_TS=$(git log -1 --format=%ct) && sh -c 'cd /tmp && env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" NODE_OPTIONS= NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 npx --yes vercel@50.15.1 --cwd "$1" --prod --yes --build-env VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA="$2" --build-env VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_TIMESTAMP="$3"' -- "$REPO_DIR" "$COMMIT_SHA" "$COMMIT_TS"
scripts.deploy: npm run render && npm run vercel
scripts.verify:
(npx prettier --check . || (npm run format && echo "
❌ Formatting changes detected! The files were modified by 'npm run format'.
Review them and commit if they look correct." && exit 1)) && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run check:agnostic && npm run test:integration && npm run test:ui-smoke && npm run semgrep && echo "
✅ VERIFICATION SUCCESSFUL" || (echo "
❌ VERIFICATION FAILED" && exit 1)
